$comment: Golden cases for the genie-scm-poc space, asked against the SAME estate the
space is configured over: the workspace.databrickspractice metric views
(mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_*). Reference SQL computes truth through MEASURE() on
the same metric views, so the check is 'does Genie's NL->SQL agree with the
governed measure definition' - the exact failure mode the space instructions
exist to prevent (summing raw columns, averaging a rate, mixing YTD windows).
The data window is 2024/2025 full years + 2026 YTD (Jan-Jun, as-of
30-Jun-2026). 'Current year' questions mean 2026 YTD, matching the space
instructions. Reference SQL names the year explicitly so truth cannot drift
even if the space's window interpretation regresses - that regression then
shows up as a reconciliation failure, which is the point.
Every case asks for a single number; notation compliance (M = thousand,
MM = million, B = billion, K forbidden) is checked automatically.

cases.question: What was the Order Fill Rate percentage for the full year 2025? Give a single number.
cases.why: The headline rate KPI on the space's own metric view. A connector that averages the rate across rows instead of letting the measure SUM-then-divide lands close and wrong.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`Order Fill Rate Pct`), 2) AS ofr_pct FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_ofr WHERE Year = 2025

cases.question: What was the OTIF percentage for the full year 2025? Give a single number.
cases.why: Second rate on the same view; pairs with mv-ofr-2025 to prove measure selection is by name, not by position.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`OTIF Pct`), 2) AS otif_pct FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_ofr WHERE Year = 2025

cases.question: What is the OTIF percentage for the current year to date? Give a single number.
cases.why: The YTD window trap: 'current year' must resolve to 2026 Jan-Jun, not full-year 2025 and not a trailing-12-month window. The reference pins Year=2026 so a window mistake reconciles as a miss.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`OTIF Pct`), 2) AS otif_pct FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_ofr WHERE Year = 2026

cases.question: How many units were ordered in total during 2025? Give a single number.
cases.why: A plain additive magnitude in the tens of millions - exactly where Roman-scale notation earns its keep (MM, never M-for-million).
cases.referenceSql: SELECT MEASURE(`Ordered Qty`) AS ordered_qty FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_ofr WHERE Year = 2025

cases.question: What was total net sales in 2024? Give a single figure.
cases.why: Currency at billion scale (~1.77B). Checks both the measure path and that the B suffix is applied at the right magnitude.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`Net Sales USD`), 0) AS net_sales_usd FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_performance WHERE Year = 2024

cases.question: What is net sales for the current year to date? Give a single figure.
cases.why: The partial-year trap on a currency measure: 2026 YTD (~1.03B) vs a naive full-year expectation. A connector projecting or comparing against full-year 2025 misses by ~45%.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`Net Sales USD`), 0) AS net_sales_usd FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_performance WHERE Year = 2026

cases.question: What was total COGS in 2025? Give a single figure.
cases.why: A lower-is-better currency measure; also verifies the connector distinguishes COGS from net sales on the same view.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`COGS USD`), 0) AS cogs_usd FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_performance WHERE Year = 2025

cases.question: What is the gross margin percentage for the current year to date? Give a single number.
cases.why: A derived rate (sales minus COGS over sales) that CANNOT be computed by summing one column - the measure must be used as defined.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_performance WHERE Year = 2026

cases.question: What were total GHG emissions in tonnes CO2e for 2024? Give a single number.
cases.why: Sustainability magnitude (~2.5MM tonnes) on the operations view; the down-is-good direction is covered by guidance, the NUMBER is covered here.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`GHG Emissions tCO2e`), 0) AS ghg_tco2e FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_operations WHERE Year = 2024

cases.question: What are GHG emissions in tonnes CO2e for the current year to date? Give a single number.
cases.why: YTD window + declining-trend measure together: 1.14MM only if the window is right.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`GHG Emissions tCO2e`), 0) AS ghg_tco2e FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_operations WHERE Year = 2026

cases.question: How many units were produced in the current year to date? Give a single number.
cases.why: Additive production volume on the operations view, second YTD-window check on a different fact.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT MEASURE(`Units Produced`) AS units_produced FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_operations WHERE Year = 2026

cases.question: How many hours were worked across all plants in 2024? Give a single number.
cases.why: The denominator LTIR/TRIR depend on; if this drifts, every safety rate silently drifts with it.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT MEASURE(`Hours Worked`) AS hours_worked FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_operations WHERE Year = 2024

cases.question: What was the forecast accuracy percentage for the full year 2025? Give a single number.
cases.why: A WMAPE-derived measure with an ABS() inside - unreproducible by any naive aggregation, so agreement is strong evidence the measure was actually used.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`Forecast Accuracy Pct`), 2) AS forecast_accuracy_pct FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_performance WHERE Year = 2025

cases.question: What was the energy intensity in kWh per unit produced for 2025? Give a single number.
cases.why: A small ratio (single-digit kWh/unit): catches unit-scale errors that a percent-tolerance check on big magnitudes never sees.
cases.referenceSql: SELECT ROUND(MEASURE(`Energy Intensity kWh per Unit`), 3) AS energy_intensity FROM workspace.databrickspractice.mtr_pp_syn_ltm_sc_fct_operations WHERE Year = 2025
